note: Regional park on the west shore of Meeting Lake, 13 km NE of Rabbit Lake, among private cabins; sandy swimming beach, marina and boat launch, mini golf, concession, gas and a round hall. Campsites sit behind the ball diamond, a walk from the beach. Mostly seasonal: about 30 of its 84 sites are sold by the night. Sites 43 and 45 are short (18 ft). --Claude
summary: Keep (regional park, local). 30 nightly 30 A + water sites ($30) plus 54 seasonal sites and a group site; Let's Camp live; 2025 season May 16 - Sep 2. Not waterfront kept (campsites ~100+ m back behind the ball diamond and round hall). Fees, sewer false, dump/water/flush filled; pin should move ~410 m north to the campsite field.
flags: LONG-STAY (local): 30 nightly of 84 campsites (36%) - 'We also have 54 serviced seasonal campsites' (saskregionalparks.ca). Nightly rate and online booking posted; no wording discouraging nightly guests. Note says 'Mostly seasonal'. The 'weekly booking only online until April 14 (minimum 7 nights)' rule is an early-booking window, not a standing minimum.
GOOGLE: 4.6 (30 reviews) on the place the search returned (its phone 306-824-2076 and website match the park).

WATERFRONT: 'not waterfront' kept. Let's Camp's site map puts the nightly rows west of the ball diamond, with the round hall, concession and public beach between them and the lake; on Esri the campsite field is about 100-200 m from the shore.

PIN: stored 53.19950,-107.70950 is at the south end of the cabin subdivision by the park gate road (near Regional Parks' GPS 53.19985,-107.71028). Suggest 53.2027,-107.7065 (the treed campsite field south of the ball diamond and round hall, read from the Let's Camp map against Esri z17), about 410 m NNE. Let's Camp's own point 53.20306,-107.70782 sits among cabins and is not the campground.

WEBSITE: both stored links live. The park's WordPress site carries injected Norwegian casino spam on its home page and a junk 'COVID' post - it is still the park's own site (rates, rules, contact are current), but the reviewer may prefer to list the Let's Camp link first.
SEASON: only 2025 dates are posted (association page); written with a note.
SITES: stored count 30 kept (nightly sites); Let's Camp lists exactly 30 numbered sites (40-47, 62-83) plus Group, Cabin and Hall. The home page says '37 camp sites and a cabin' (not reconciled).
INCLUSION_EVIDENCE: stored text describes this park; fine.
